title: Agent gold set, version 0
description: One agent's gold set: reviewed inputs and their correct output, as the canonical string items the agent should produce, with the precision and recall threshold each tier must clear. Product spec Section 11.

agent.description: The agent catalog id, for example spec_reader or modeler.

thresholds.description: Minimum precision and recall per tier; a tier with no cases in this gold set needs no threshold. Set from the pilot baseline, never invented.

input.description: Where the reviewed input lives, for a human to find it (a path, a citation).

expected.description: The correct output, as canonical string items; empty means the agent should produce nothing for this case.
